entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Silahdar Yusuf Pasha also known as Jusuf Mašković, was an Ottoman vezir and admiral, known for conquering Chania in western Crete in only 54 days in 1645 during the Cretan War (1645–69). He built a large han, or Turkish inn, at Vrana in 1644, which still stands today.
